scripts.build: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api build && corepack pnpm --filter user-web build && corepack pnpm --filter admin-web build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter user-web typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter admin-web typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter api typecheck
scripts.lint: corepack pnpm --filter user-web lint && corepack pnpm --filter admin-web lint
scripts.test: corepack pnpm --dir apps/api test && corepack pnpm --filter user-web test && corepack pnpm --filter admin-web test
